source_caption:
🎬 The Borgias (2011–2013)

The Borgias follows the powerful and controversial Borgia family as they rise to prominence in Renaissance Italy, where religion, politics, wealth, and ambition are deeply intertwined. Set in 1492, the story begins with Rodrigo Borgia’s determination to secure the papacy, eventually becoming Pope Alexander VI through political manipulation, strategic alliances, and calculated deals. Once in power, he works tirelessly to strengthen his family’s influence while facing dangerous rivals, corrupt officials, and powerful noble families determined to bring him down. His ambitious son Cesare struggles between his responsibilities within the Church and his desire for military and political power, while his younger son Juan seeks recognition through his position as a military commander. Meanwhile, Lucrezia Borgia becomes an important figure in the family’s political ambitions as her father arranges marriages designed to secure valuable alliances. As the Borgias expand their influence, they become entangled in conspiracies, betrayals, forbidden relationships, violent conflicts, and dangerous struggles for control over Italy. Behind the magnificent palaces, elaborate ceremonies, and luxurious lifestyles lies a world filled with suspicion, deception, and ruthless competition. As enemies grow stronger and family loyalties are tested, the Borgias must confront the consequences of their relentless pursuit of power. Combining lavish historical settings, political intrigue, dramatic relationships, and intense storytelling, the series explores ambition, corruption, religion, loyalty, betrayal, and the extraordinary influence of one of history’s most infamous families.

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Crime • Political Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 50–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Neil Jordan

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+ with Showtime, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Borgias is an historical drama television series created by Neil Jordan. It ran for three seasons from 2011 to 2013, when it was cancelled. Set in Renaissance-era Italy, the series follows the Borgia family in their scandalous ascension to the papacy. It stars Jeremy Irons as Pope Alexander VI with François Arnaud as Cesare, Holliday Grainger as Lucrezia and David Oakes as Juan. Colm Feore also stars as Cardinal della Rovere. The Borgias premiered on April 3, 2011 on Showtime in the US and Bravo! in Canada. That June it received its major television network premiere on the CTV Television Network.
